questions.task: Each plan runs its steps from left to right. Pick the plan that leaves marks at 74.

payload.spec: Asha keeps a count in marks. It starts at 64. First 5 is taken away, then 15 is added. At the end marks must be 74.

options.why: Each = replaces the old value instead of changing it, so marks ends as 15.

options.text: marks = 64, then marks = marks - 5, then marks = marks + 15
